title: cnicus ciliatus
intro: Cnicus ciliatus, commonly known as Purple Mullein or Ciliated Jacobea, is a flowering plant species native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Cnicus ciliatus are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, making it a popular remedy for various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Cnicus ciliatus include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
